en.headline: Lingnan University drops external English test for graduation
en.dek: Undergraduates must now pass university English courses instead of achieving a set IELTS score; the change took effect immediately after the Senate approved it earlier this week.
body: Lingnan University announced on Thursday that it has revised the English language graduation requirement for undergraduates, replacing the previous need to obtain a minimum score on an external test such as IELTS with the completion and passing of designated internal English courses.

The university said the revision, which took effect immediately, aims to make better use of teaching resources and strengthen support for students’ English learning through continuous classroom instruction rather than a single external examination. Students will be grouped by their English proficiency on admission, covering university English courses, electives and discipline-related professional communication courses.

Lau Chi-pang, special adviser to the president on publicity, told reporters that the university no longer saw a need for an exit exam, as 99 per cent of undergraduates had passed the requirement since it was introduced about eight years ago. The Centre for English and Additional Languages is offering a new English Language Enhancement programme this academic year for students who need additional support.

Some observers have raised concerns that removing the external benchmark could lower standards, but the university maintained that the change better matches students’ learning needs and prepares them for further study or work.

zh.headline: 嶺南大學取消本科生校外英語試畢業要求
zh.dek: 學生只需修畢並及格指定校內英語課程即可畢業，取代過往須達雅思指定分數的規定，有關修訂本周教務會通過後即時生效。
body: 嶺南大學周四宣布修訂本科生英語語言畢業要求，不再要求學生透過校外考試如雅思取得指定分數，改為修畢大學指定的英語必修課程並取得及格即可畢業。
校方指，修訂即時生效，目的是更善用教學資源，並透過持續課堂學習加強學生英語支援，而非依賴單一外部考試。課程會按學生入學時英語水平分組，涵蓋大學英語必修課、選修課及與學科相關的專業溝通課程。
校長特別顧問劉智鵬向傳媒表示，校方認為不再需要校外畢業試，因為自約八年前推出以來，九成九本科生都能通過有關要求。英語及外語教學中心本學年推出全新英語語言提升課程，為有需要學生提供額外支援。
有意見擔心取消外部基準或會降低標準，校方則強調修訂更切合學生學習需要，有助畢業後升學或就業。
